list.label: Job
list.query: select distinct job from metrics.ci_runs order by 1
list.definition: select distinct job from metrics.ci_runs order by 1

panels.title: Job time, latest run
panels.description: Wall-clock time of each job's latest run, from its first step to the upload.

targets.rawSql: select started_at as time, job as metric, job_seconds as value from metrics.ci_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at) and job in ($job) and outcome in ($outcome) order by 1

panels.title: Job time, last 7 days vs the 7 before
panels.description: Change in each job's median wall-clock time. Positive means slower.

targets.rawSql:
select job,
  (percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by job_seconds) filter (where started_at > now() - interval '7 days'))
  / nullif(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by job_seconds) filter (where started_at <= now() - interval '7 days'), 0) - 1 as change
from metrics.ci_runs where started_at > now() - interval '14 days' and job in ($job) and outcome in ($outcome)
group by job order by job

panels.title: Tests, latest run
panels.description: Number of tests in each job's latest run.

targets.rawSql: select started_at as time, job as metric, tests as value from metrics.ci_runs where $__timeFilter(started_at) and job in ($job) and outcome in ($outcome) order by 1

panels.title: Job wall-clock time per run
panels.description: Each point is one CI job run. The average line smooths out runner noise, so slow creep shows.

panels.title: Test runner time per run
panels.description: The test runner's own wall-clock time, as Bun reports it.

panels.title: Tests getting slower
panels.description: Median duration in the last 7 days against the 30 days before. Tests with at least 3 runs in each window, by the biggest increase.

targets.rawSql:
with t as (
  select m.file, m.name, m.duration_ms, m.recorded_at > now() - interval '7 days' as recent
  from metrics.ci_test_metrics m join metrics.ci_runs r on r.id = m.ci_run_id
  where m.recorded_at > now() - interval '37 days' and m.status = 'passed' and case when m.file like '%.docker.test.ts' then 'docker' else 'regular' end in ($kind) and r.job in ($job) and r.outcome in ($outcome)
), s as (
  select file, name,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by duration_ms) filter (where not recent) as "Before (ms)",
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by duration_ms) filter (where recent) as "Last 7 days (ms)",
    count(*) filter (where not recent) as before_runs, count(*) filter (where recent) as recent_runs
  from t group by file, name
)
select file as "File", name as "Test", "Before (ms)", "Last 7 days (ms)",
  "Last 7 days (ms)" - "Before (ms)" as "Change (ms)",
  "Last 7 days (ms)" / nullif("Before (ms)", 0) - 1 as "Change"
from s where before_runs >= 3 and recent_runs >= 3
order by "Change (ms)" desc limit 25

panels.title: Slowest tests
panels.description: Over the dashboard's time range. Passed runs only.

targets.rawSql:
select case when m.file like '%.docker.test.ts' then 'docker' else 'regular' end as "Kind", m.file as "File", m.name as "Test",
  percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by m.duration_ms) as "Median (ms)",
  percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by m.duration_ms) as "p90 (ms)",
  count(*) as "Runs"
from metrics.ci_test_metrics m join metrics.ci_runs r on r.id = m.ci_run_id
where $__timeFilter(m.recorded_at) and m.status = 'passed' and case when m.file like '%.docker.test.ts' then 'docker' else 'regular' end in ($kind) and r.job in ($job) and r.outcome in ($outcome)
group by 1, m.file, m.name order by 4 desc limit 25

panels.title: Duration of the 10 slowest tests, per run
panels.description: The tests with the highest median in the time range, narrowed by the Test filter above.

targets.rawSql:
with m as (
  select m.* from metrics.ci_test_metrics m join metrics.ci_runs r on r.id = m.ci_run_id
  where $__timeFilter(m.recorded_at) and m.status = 'passed' and case when m.file like '%.docker.test.ts' then 'docker' else 'regular' end in ($kind) and r.job in ($job) and r.outcome in ($outcome)
    and (m.file || ' ' || m.name) ~* '$test_filter'
), top as (
  select file, name from m group by file, name
  order by percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by duration_ms) desc limit 10
)
select m.recorded_at as time, m.name as metric, m.duration_ms as value
from m join top using (file, name) order by 1

panels.title: Test time per run, docker vs regular tests
panels.description: Sum of passed tests' durations in each run, split by whether the file is a .docker.test.ts.

targets.rawSql:
select r.started_at as time, case when m.file like '%.docker.test.ts' then 'docker' else 'regular' end || ' tests, ' || r.job || ' job' as metric, sum(m.duration_ms) / 1000.0 as value
from metrics.ci_test_metrics m join metrics.ci_runs r on r.id = m.ci_run_id
where $__timeFilter(r.started_at) and m.status = 'passed' and case when m.file like '%.docker.test.ts' then 'docker' else 'regular' end in ($kind) and r.job in ($job) and r.outcome in ($outcome)
group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Step times
panels.description: Each step's median and p90 time in the selected range, e.g. lint and typecheck. Skipped steps are left out.

targets.rawSql:
select r.job as "Job", s.name as "Step",
  percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by s.seconds) as "Median",
  percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by s.seconds) as "p90",
  count(*) as "Runs"
from metrics.ci_step_metrics s join metrics.ci_runs r on r.id = s.ci_run_id
where $__timeFilter(r.started_at) and s.conclusion <> 'skipped' and r.job in ($job) and r.outcome in ($outcome)
group by r.job, s.name order by min(s.position)

panels.title: Step time per run
panels.description: How long each step took, run by run. Hide steps by clicking the legend.

targets.rawSql:
select r.started_at as time, r.job || ': ' || s.name as metric, s.seconds as value
from metrics.ci_step_metrics s join metrics.ci_runs r on r.id = s.ci_run_id
where $__timeFilter(r.started_at) and s.conclusion <> 'skipped' and r.job in ($job) and r.outcome in ($outcome)
order by 1
